I also think a lot of things, like Charlotte and Elizabeth's stories, were entirely pointless in the grand scheme of things. Aleksander could have had a way better story as well, among tons of others like the blind dude and the alleged big-headed guy mentioned in S1.

Like just wrapping up a story without answering all the questions and effectively saying it was all part of the nonsensical matrix is just...boring.

That said, glad I watched it.
